# Shield (`magic-items:shield`)
**Category:** [Armor](../equipment-categories/armor.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3) | **Attunement:** No
**Variants:** [Shield +1](../magic-items/shield-1.md), [Shield +2](../magic-items/shield-2.md), [Shield +3](../magic-items/shield-3.md)

Armor (Shield)

While holding this Shield, you have a bonus to Armor Class determined by the Shield's rarity, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
